notes: The 25 µm core is the existing adhesiveless F1 core target; do not add an unaccounted copper-to-core adhesive.
The selected 200 µm PI stiffener and 50 µm bond give 0.3132 mm nominal at an exposed single-copper contact, including the 3.2 µm nominal Ni/Au finish.
Back copper must be absent in the relieved contact zone. A local back-coverlay opening is proposed for the two nail row foils; it is not yet fabrication artwork.
Hirose's FPC construction example uses a thinner stiffener, but this plan follows the >=0.188 mm callout on its dimensioned terminal drawing.
Finished thickness and surface finish need fabricator confirmation and measured coupons. Adding the finish changes the nominal active stack and must be included in the final assembly drawing.
This contract does not resolve the source-frame mating plane, dynamic slack, sealing or physical qualification.
